component.name: Musializer-RS
component.summary: High-performance, GPU-accelerated audio visualizer written in Rust

description.p: Musializer-RS is a native, hardware-accelerated desktop audio visualizer bringing 60+ FPS fluid spectrum analysis, oscilloscope waveforms, radial pulses, and deterministic MP4 video rendering.

ul.li: Pure-Rust multi-format audio decoding (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, AAC).
Hardware SIMD Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) with Hann windowing.
Asymmetric Exponential Moving Average (EMA) and floating peak hold dynamics.
Customizable album art center hub with countdown and elapsed timestamps.
Deterministic offline 60 FPS video export via automatic FFmpeg piping.
In-app automated version updates and release changelogs.

description.p: Musializer-RS v1.0.0 Major Release: Full cross-platform release with high-performance desktop visualizer and newly launched 120 FPS Flutter mobile application with offline MP4 video export and in-app auto-updates.
